purpose: Fresh execution on the format-aware acquisition runtime: produce and independently semantically verify an XLSX workbook from canonical Brain data, exposing the next unsupported acquisition/composition class without stale mission state.
goal: Read canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json. Create an XLSX spreadsheet workbook at canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/VERIFIED_CAPABILITIES.xlsx containing exactly one row for every VERIFIED_BOUND_CAPABILITY with columns capability_id, status, source_type, provides, and incremental_spend_usd. Finally independently reopen the workbook and verify that every VERIFIED_BOUND_CAPABILITY from the registry appears exactly once, that no non-verified capability appears, and that every row's values match the canonical registry.
